info.title: CrawlGraph
info.description: Free backlink intelligence powered by Common Crawl's hyperlink graph.

post.summary: Look up referring domains for a target domain
post.description:
Public-API backlink lookup.

Validates ``domain`` and ``release_id`` (400 ``validation_error`` on
failure), charges one call against the caller's monthly
``backlinks`` quota (429 ``quota_exceeded`` on overflow), then runs
the same DuckDB query the internal route uses and returns the
sliced results.

Request a free-tier API key (15 backlink calls per month; gap
analysis requires the $99 lifetime tier). The key is emailed to the address you provide - it is never
returned in this response. One active key per email. Lifetime
customers manage keys at /account instead.

schema.title: Response Request Free Key Api V1 Free Key Post

get.description:
Return the list of releases the API can serve queries from.

Does NOT charge against the caller's quota.

post.description:
Queue a gap-analysis job and return a poll URL.

Validates the input domains, charges one call against the caller's
monthly ``gap`` quota (429 ``quota_exceeded`` on overflow), creates
a row in ``export_jobs`` (``kind="gap"``), and schedules the worker
via FastAPI's ``BackgroundTasks``. The poll endpoint reads the same
table and is owner-scoped.

get.description:
Return the current status of a gap-analysis job.

Owner-scoped - jobs that don't exist or that belong to another user
both return ``404 not_found`` (``get_job_for_user`` enforces the
ownership check; we can't distinguish the two cases, which is the
point - never leak another user's job ids).

get.summary: Compare inbound-link observations across indexed releases
get.description: Return observed additions, absences, and authority movement.

V1BacklinkItem.title: V1BacklinkItem
V1BacklinkItem.description:
One referring-domain row in the response.

``tld`` is the last label of ``linking_domain`` (no leading dot).
``cg_authority`` is a 0..100 log-rank percentile from the Common
Crawl harmonic-centrality ranking (higher = more authoritative).
``cg_rank`` is the raw PageRank position across the whole graph
(1 = top-ranked domain on the web). Both are NULL for domains
that don't appear in the ranks file.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Target domain to look up backlinks for, e.g. 'example.com'.

release_id.title: Release Id
release_id.description: Common Crawl release id. Defaults to the latest release.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Max number of result rows to return (1..10000).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Result ordering. 'authority' (default) sorts by cg_authority DESC then num_hosts DESC. 'hosts' preserves the legacy num_hosts DESC ordering.

total_linking_domains.title: Total Linking Domains
total_linking_domains.description: Number of distinct linking domains retrieved before the `limit` slice was applied.

returned.title: Returned
returned.description: Number of rows actually included in `results`.

cg_authority.title: Cg Authority
cg_authority.description: 0..100 log-rank percentile for the queried `domain`. NULL when the domain is missing from the ranks file.

cg_rank.title: Cg Rank
cg_rank.description: Raw PageRank position of the queried `domain` (1 = top). NULL when the domain is missing from the ranks file.

V1GapStatusResponse.description:
``GET /api/v1/gap-analysis/{job_id}`` response.

Single model with optional fields rather than a discriminated union -
consumers can branch on ``status`` and pick out the field set
relevant to that state.
